title: Configure finite disk cache max age for cached images
objective: Configure cached network images to use a finite disk-cache max age, defaulting to seven days.
acceptance_criteria: CachedNetworkImage and CachedNetworkImageProvider usage is wired to a cache manager or equivalent config with finite maxAge
Default disk-cache max age is seven days unless an existing app-level constant already defines a stricter value
The cache configuration is centralized instead of duplicated across every call site
Versioned cacheKey behavior from L3 is preserved
No new direct dependency is added unless already available transitively through cached_network_image
flutter analyze for edited image widgets reports no new errors
deliverables: Updated cached image call sites to use the finite max-age config
